section_item_translations.title: What is Push-to-Talk over Cellular (PoC)?
section_item_translations.description: It's walkie-talkie-style communication that runs over cellular data or Wi-Fi instead of a dedicated radio network. Press a button to talk to a channel or to one person, on compatible devices.

section_item_translations.title: How is AM² PTT different from AM² Command Center?
section_item_translations.description: AM² PTT focuses on voice, location, and optional video through Android handhelds. AM² Command Center focuses on body cameras and visual workflows for supervisors. Both are administered through WebAdmin.

section_item_translations.title: What is the difference between Managed SaaS and On-Premise?
section_item_translations.description: With Managed SaaS, AM² operates the platform infrastructure for you. With On-Premise, the platform runs on your infrastructure and your team operates it, while AM² provides the software, implementation guidance, and updates under your agreement.

section_item_translations.title: Does AM² need a specific network?
section_item_translations.description: AM² needs compatible IP connectivity between devices and the platform, such as cellular data or Wi-Fi. Audio quality depends on coverage, bandwidth, latency, the device, and your network setup.

section_item_translations.title: Does AM² manufacture its own devices?
section_item_translations.description: No. AM² uses selected white-label devices from OEM partners and configures them for the AM² platform. Specifications and certifications depend on the model you choose.

section_item_translations.title: Is AM² communication encrypted?
section_item_translations.description: Connections between the apps and the platform use HTTPS/WSS with TLS, which protects data while it is in transit.

section_item_translations.title: How is AM² priced?
section_item_translations.description: Pricing depends on device type and quantity, active users or capacity, features, deployment model, implementation, and support. Contact our team for a proposal based on your requirements.

section_item_translations.title: How can I evaluate AM²?
section_item_translations.description: Book a technical demo and tell us your expected unit count, operating locations, network environment, and preference for Managed SaaS or On-Premise.

section_item_translations.title: Apa itu Push-to-Talk over Cellular (PoC)?
section_item_translations.description: Komunikasi ala HT yang berjalan di jaringan data seluler atau Wi-Fi, bukan di jaringan radio khusus. Cukup tekan tombol untuk bicara ke satu channel atau satu orang, menggunakan perangkat yang kompatibel.

section_item_translations.title: Apa bedanya AM² PTT dan AM² Command Center?
section_item_translations.description: AM² PTT berfokus pada komunikasi suara, lokasi, dan video opsional lewat HT Android. AM² Command Center berfokus pada body camera dan alur kerja visual untuk supervisor. Keduanya dikelola melalui WebAdmin.

section_item_translations.title: Apa perbedaan Managed SaaS dan On-Premise?
section_item_translations.description: Pada Managed SaaS, infrastruktur platform dioperasikan oleh AM². Pada On-Premise, platform berjalan di infrastruktur Anda dan dioperasikan tim Anda, sementara AM² menyediakan software, panduan implementasi, dan pembaruan sesuai perjanjian.

section_item_translations.title: Apakah AM² membutuhkan jaringan tertentu?
section_item_translations.description: AM² membutuhkan konektivitas IP yang kompatibel antara perangkat dan platform, misalnya data seluler atau Wi-Fi. Kualitas suara bergantung pada cakupan sinyal, bandwidth, latensi, perangkat, dan konfigurasi jaringan Anda.

section_item_translations.title: Apakah perangkatnya buatan AM² sendiri?
section_item_translations.description: Tidak. AM² menggunakan perangkat white-label pilihan dari mitra OEM dan mengonfigurasinya untuk platform AM². Spesifikasi dan sertifikasi bergantung pada model yang Anda pilih.

section_item_translations.title: Apakah komunikasi AM² terenkripsi?
section_item_translations.description: Koneksi antara aplikasi dan platform menggunakan HTTPS/WSS dengan TLS untuk melindungi data selama transit.
